subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: mr. hasan a renowned english teacher has been teaching in our school for the past five years he is honest and sincere he is our favourite teacher we love him much Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation Mr. Hasan, a renowned English teacher, has been teaching in our school for the past five years. He is honest and sincere. He is our favourite teacher. We love him much. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 216
